title: Keep exact rejected Mira video-frame identity evidence through recurring router preflight
root_cause: Canonical instagram media router preflight unconditionally converts assetMaterialized to last_error=null and writes obligation fallback last_error=MEDIA_ASSET_REQUIRED. After genuine submit_asset proof rejection and an explicit diagnostic write this readiness step erases the failure reason and next action while preserving WAITING_PROOF. Actual proof remains in media_proof_evidence but actionable status regresses.
impact: Existing agents repeatedly rediscover MEDIA_ASSET_REQUIRED instead of the proven frame-identity-below-0.94 cause. This increases pointless retries/provider spend and loses root-cause continuity; it never creates Instagram external readback.

evidence.existing_exact_proof_fingerprints: Stored in public.powerhouse_media_proof_evidence_v1; no new proof table

fix: Record VIDEO_FRAME_CANONICAL_MIRA_FACE_MISMATCH once from the real rejected verifier response with CAS on the existing media job; update the canonical obligation diagnostic only while still BLOCKED/unposted; preserve exact failure and next action across subsequent preflight polls. Keep the existing verifier, master reference, 0.94 threshold, status and selected media unchanged.
prevention_rule: Never transform a confirmed MEDIA_PROOF_REJECTED into MEDIA_ASSET_REQUIRED during a readiness-only poll; never erase last_error on assetMaterialized while WAITING_PROOF unless genuinely new exact provider proof has passed. Keep no-dispatch and idempotency invariant, emit a synthetic regression before protected promotion.
release_gates: Required CI and CodeQL on final SHA
existing Supabase router provider source parity
no real external Instagram post marked without full 3-frame proof and provider readback
outcome: CANDIDATE; a regression and source change are drafted. Does not make Instagram LIVE_PROVEN, and PR #4643 retains independent SQL-proof validation authority.
